user.title: Set up FoxESS Globird Energy Observer
user.description: Choose exactly one FoxESS owner: observer, local Modbus, or FoxCloud Mode Scheduler. Only the ported ZEROHERO export policy may write automatically. The Safety Lock is ON by default.

data.name: Site name
data.battery_power_entity: Signed battery power sensor (required for solar spill)
data.battery_charge_positive: Battery power sensor is positive when charging
data.super_export_rate_per_kwh: ZEROHERO export rate during bonus window ($/kWh)
data.grid_import_positive: Grid sensor is positive when importing
data.service_import_limit_a: Service import limit per phase (A; 0 if not commissioned)
data.export_limit_kw: Regulated export limit (kW; 0 if not commissioned)
data.inverter_charge_limit_kw: Inverter charge limit (kW; 0 if not commissioned)
data.inverter_discharge_limit_kw: Inverter discharge limit (kW; 0 if not commissioned)
data.house_load_entity: Protected house-load sensor (optional; non-heater base load at the Working Single Phase Pilot Site)
data.foxess_work_mode_entity: FoxESS work-mode selector (required for ZEROHERO export or diagnostics)
data.foxess_force_charge_power_entity: FoxESS force-charge power number (required for diagnostics)
data.foxess_force_discharge_power_entity: FoxESS force-discharge power number (required for ZEROHERO export or diagnostics)
data.ev_at_home_entity: EV at-home evidence entity (required when mandatory EV baseline is non-zero)
data.ev_cable_connected_entity: EV cable-connected entity (required when mandatory EV baseline is non-zero)
data.ev_lifetime_energy_entity: Tessie cumulative lifetime energy-used sensor (optional driving learning)
data.ev_smart_socket_entity: Smart-socket power switch (required only for smart-socket supply)
data.ev_smart_socket_current_limit_a: Commissioned smart-socket current limit (A; 0 when unused)
data.ev_smart_socket_power_switching: Allow zero-demand smart-socket power switching outside the free window
data.ev_smart_recovery_post_power_seconds: Recovery settle time after socket power-on (seconds)
data.ev_smart_recovery_rearm_seconds: Healthy charging duration before recovery rearm (seconds)
data.ev_smart_recovery_idle_current_a: Maximum actual current treated as no charging during recovery (A)
data.ev_free_window_settle_minutes: Battery-charging settle time before house-priority control (minutes)
data.ev_learning_minimum_samples: EV driving samples required for P85 learning
data.site_grid_current_entity: Most-loaded phase signed grid current (A; required for multiphase EV control)
data.ev_allowance_guard_enabled: Protect the configured whole-site free-energy allowance
data.ev_solar_spill_battery_soc_percent: Battery SoC required for solar-spill charging (%)
data.ev_pre_free_backfill_enabled: Enable latest-start reserve-aware pre-free EV backfill
data.ev_telemetry_max_age_seconds: Maximum age for outside-window power telemetry (seconds)
data.ev_telemetry_max_skew_seconds: Maximum timestamp skew between outside-window power sensors (seconds)
data.ev_control_commissioned: EV mappings and electrical limits commissioned
data.force_discharge_finish: Force Discharge finish (normally one minute after bonus window)
data.ev_protected_baseline_a: Mandatory connected-EV baseline until free power (A; 0 if none)
data.zero_import_threshold_kw: ZEROHERO average import threshold (kWh/hour; contract says 0.03)
data.foxess_control_owner: FoxESS control owner (never mix cloud scheduler and Modbus)
data.automatic_control_enabled: Enable HEO Local Modbus master gate (ZEROHERO export only)
data.automatic_export_enabled: Enable automatic ZEROHERO export (Local Modbus owner only)
data.ev_automatic_control_enabled: Request automatic EV control (independent of FoxESS ownership)

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure FoxESS Globird Energy Observer
reconfigure.description: Update site mappings, limits, the exclusive FoxESS owner, or the ported ZEROHERO export gate. Safety Lock ON blocks all hardware writes.

error.invalid_entity: Select a valid Home Assistant entity.
error.incomplete_foxess_mapping: Map all three FoxESS control entities, or leave all three unmapped.
error.incomplete_ev_mapping: Commissioned EV control requires every Tessie telemetry and actuator mapping.
error.solar_spill_battery_power_mapping_requir: Solar-spill charging requires an explicitly mapped signed battery-power sensor.
error.outside_ev_policy_requires_local_modbus: Solar-spill and pre-free EV charging require Local Modbus to be selected as the FoxESS control owner.
error.multiphase_current_mapping_required: Commissioned multiphase EV control requires a signed most-loaded phase grid-current sensor.
error.invalid_ev_location_mode: Choose Auto, Home, or Away EV location policy.
error.invalid_ev_priority: Choose house-battery or EV free-window priority.
error.invalid_ev_charge_path: Choose direct EVSE or smart socket.
error.incomplete_smart_socket_mapping: Commissioned smart-socket control requires its switch mapping and a current limit at least as high as the commissioned EV minimum.
error.invalid_site_limits: Check capacity, floor, reserve, charger, inverter, current, and voltage limits.
error.invalid_schedule: Choose different free-charge times and a non-negative fallback.
error.invalid_foxess_control_owner: Choose observer only, local Modbus, or FoxCloud Mode Scheduler.
